About this hub

This is the lab workbench: every game is a labeled cartridge on the shelf. Press Play to dock it into the glowing play bay. No accounts, no cookies, no third-party scripts or fonts.

TSL

What you get

  • Self-made games with recorded licence and source in each detail page.
  • Iframe docks only after Play — nothing heavy loads until you ask (or open in a new tab).
  • Popularity sorted by a documented formula; “recently played” stays on your device only.

Lab cartridge workbench

Cards are cartridges with a spine, notch, label plate, and edge connector. Press/hover flips the label through a real screenshot. Play docks the cartridge into the bay — one memorable beat, no video or 3D backgrounds.

Audience & boundaries

Pip's Bloom Isle is aimed at casual players 13+. We only list what each build already ships. See the content policy for licence rules.
